title: Wonderful day tour
text:
Our guide João Ramos was amazing and very knowledgeable. Not to mention his patience in handling our group.
Sintra was scenically beautiful and filled with historical sights too.

title: Walking tour
text: Jean Carlos Vargas Parrondo spoke really good English. He did the talk in English and then Spanish as the main group were English. He was very knowledgeable and able to answer all questions. He took us to beautiful places of Seville. Very enjoyable.

title: Short but Great Experience
text: Pablo Mcgrath Garcia is smart and informative. He share history of Seville and food recommendation as well. He is a very well rounded guide as he shares his knowledge to us in both English and Spanish. Vamos!

title: Great way to discover Sevilla
text: Pablo McGrath Garcia was An amazing guide. At 21 years old his knowledge and ability to swap between Spanish and English was impressive   What a great way to see the historical side of the old town and learn so much.  He also gave great tips and recommendations for what to see and do in Sevilla

title: Good tour.
text: Excellent. Yesterday was a rainy day, but I was still able to enjoy it. Wonderful day today. Alejandro was very attentive.
author: V521EEevelina

title: Great guides, honest staff
text: Got the 48 hour ticket and am writing when half way through. Two excellent guides for the walking tours, Pablo (half Australian) and Hugo, who balanced Spanish and English information superbly.  Informative, entertaining and friendly. Wet weather was not ideal but dodged the showers and enjoyed the round trip. Best of all, despite carelessly dropping my wallet on the bus, it was safely returned to me courtesy to a kind fellow tourist and honest bus driver.
author: N3581XGmatth
